column1: # The Chinese documentation as wiki pages: the file in the repository, a tab, and the page it becomes.
# The page name is what a reader sees in the address bar and what a link between pages has to name, so
# this is the one place to look when a page is added, removed or renamed. A page name may not contain a
# space. Order here is the order the sidebar lists the pages in; the sidebar itself is wiki-sidebar.md,
# and both files have to agree, which the publishing script checks before it writes anything.
